name: regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 2

function.text: RIMS2 is the approved symbol for regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in small GTPase binding; structural constituent of presynaptic active zone; adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include cone-rod synaptic disorder syndrome, congenital nonprogressive (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Esophageal carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.
